section: Environmental Studies · Ch44 — Universe — Deep Practice 2
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth. This can only happen on a:

options.option_text: Any random day of the month

explanation: A solar eclipse requires the Moon between Sun and Earth, which only occurs at New Moon. A lunar eclipse occurs at Full Moon instead.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch44 — Universe — Deep Practice 2
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Seasons change on Earth mainly because of:

options.option_text: The tilt of Earth's axis combined with its revolution around the Sun
The Earth's rotation on its own axis alone
Changes in the Moon's distance from Earth
The Sun moving closer to and farther from Earth each month

explanation: Earth's axial tilt combined with its yearly revolution produces seasons. Rotation alone causes day-night, not seasons.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch44 — Our Country: Land & Mountains
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: The highest peak in India, Kangchenjunga, is located in which mountain range?
explanation: Kangchenjunga, on the India-Nepal border, is part of the Himalayas — the world's youngest and highest fold mountain system.
